relationships.subject: Gabapentin
relationships.evidence_quote: gabapentin treatment substantially mitigates pain hypersensitivity in both the combined chemotherapy and paclitaxel-administered groups

key_findings: Combination chemotherapy produced longer-lasting hypersensitivity than paclitaxel alone (to day 56 vs day 35) in rats.
Both models upregulated DRG and spinal TRPV1, CGRP, Substance P, TNF-alpha and IL-1beta; combination model also raised NR2B; gabapentin reversed these changes.
